items.title_en: August rents: condos flat, HDB rents dip 0.7%
items.summary_zh: 据99.co/SRX估算，8月公寓租金与7月持平（比去年高2.5%），组屋租金环比跌0.7%，成交量也回落。租金整体稳，续约时可以拿这些数字跟房东谈，别轻易接受大幅加租。
items.summary_en: 99.co/SRX estimates show condo rents flat in August (2.5% above a year ago) while HDB rents slipped 0.7% month on month, with fewer leases signed. Rents are stable, so use these numbers when negotiating a renewal instead of accepting a big increase.

items.title_zh: 警方提醒：冒充移民局与假PR代办骗局
items.title_en: Police warn of fake ICA calls and PR-help ad scams
items.summary_zh: 警方和移民局提醒：有人冒充ICA来电，再转给假“中国官员”要钱；也有社交媒体广告假称能帮办PR收费。政府人员不会让你转账或把电话转给警察，申请PR请直接走ICA官网。
items.summary_en: Police and ICA warn of callers posing as ICA officers who hand you to a fake 'China official' demanding money, and of social media ads selling fake PR application help. Officials never ask you to transfer money or pass your call to police; apply for PR only via ICA's own website.

items.title_zh: 没看房之前，一分钱都别付
items.title_en: Tip: never pay before you view the home
items.summary_zh: CEA提醒：看房和租房都不需要先付钱。先把中介的电话号码输入CEA公共名册查一下，亲自去看房，租金订金只直接付给屋主，用银行转账或划线支票这类能追查的方式。
items.summary_en: CEA says no payment is needed to book a viewing or secure a rental. Search the agent's phone number on the CEA Public Register, view the home in person, and pay only the owner directly by a traceable method such as bank transfer or crossed cheque.

items.title_zh: 租约签完14天内要盖印花税
items.title_en: Tip: stamp your tenancy agreement within 14 days
items.summary_zh: IRAS规定：在新加坡签的租约要在签署后14天内网上盖印花税（在海外签的，入境后30天内），逾期最多罚4倍。拿到印花证书（Stamp Certificate）对租客也是一种保障，先和房东说好谁来付。
items.summary_en: IRAS says a lease signed in Singapore must be e-stamped within 14 days (30 days after arrival if signed overseas), or penalties of up to 4 times the duty may apply. The Stamp Certificate protects tenants too, so agree with your landlord upfront on who pays.
